item.title: Supermail 0.2.584
item.description:
• Call the inbox tabs Super Labels, never "split" (wording only)
  • The Undo chip sits at the bottom of the inbox, not over the emails
  • A Google Group keeps its own name, not the last outside sender's (accounting@ showed as CannaBIZ)
  • Smart Compose: gray words finish the sentence, Tab adds them, with a Settings switch (on-device Apple Intelligence)
  • Krinkov side panel shows the sender's lead (Mac + iPhone)
  • An email's first line sits one line under its names
  • Saved-mail search reads after:, before: and has:attachment, so dated searches show matches while typing
  • AI search: type a sentence, search it as Gmail search words (on-device Apple Intelligence)
  • Table cells wrap between words, not mid-letter
  • Dragging accounts works in the shipped app
  • Z undoes every L, adding or removing, on one email or a selection
  • Create a Gmail label from the label box (L, V, Cmd+K)
  • The ☰ lines up with the bottom of "Inbox"
  • Dark mode: emails that paint their own backgrounds (SRT's) read light-on-dark, not on a white card
  • Send Feedback on Mac and iPhone, emailed from your own Gmail
  • A clean account switcher from the top, with a picture per account
  • ⌘J fills in an attached Word or PDF form and attaches it to the reply
  • Supermail Staff: notarized download and a no-sign-in update feed
  • Your Gmail labels in the side menu, on the Mac and iPhone
  • Encrypt mail, drafts, pictures and sign-ins on the Mac and iPhone
  • A side menu (☰) with Sent and the other folders, on the Mac and iPhone
  • Check the release token first, and say when it expires
  • A new message is a card like Superhuman's
  • Remove Account: delete an account's data from this Mac or iPhone and revoke Google access
  • Sign the staff Mac app with the Developer ID
